senses.gloss: the condition of a Ḥaber with reference to levitical pureness; the Order of Ḥăberim.
units: Bekh. 30ᵇ הבא לקבל דברי ח׳ he who comes before scholars to take upon himself the obligations of a ḥaber.

<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 3:4">Tosef. Dem. III, 4</cite> <he>דוחין אותו מחֲבירוּתוֹ</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>מחבורתו</he>) is expelled from the order; Y. ib. II, 23ᵃ top <he>מחבור׳</he> (cor. acc); a. fr.
Y. Ber. V, 9ᵃ bot. אפי׳ תואר ח׳ וכ׳ even the appellation of fellowship (if you had called us ḥăberim) would not have been unbecoming to us.
